function.name: impl_from_decoder
function.description: This function returns a pointer to the png_decoder structure that contains the given decoder structure.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the decoder structure that is contained within a png_decoder structure.

function.return_type: struct png_decoder*; Pointer to the png_decoder structure that contains the given decoder structure.

function.name: user_read_data
function.description: This function reads data from a stream into a buffer, and throws an error if the reading fails or the number of bytes read does not match the expected length.

parameters.name: png_ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to a PNG structure

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer where the data will be read into

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: The expected number of bytes to read

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: png_decoder_initialize
function.description: This function initializes a PNG decoder. It reads the PNG file, sets the appropriate color format, and prepares the image for further processing.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the decoder interface.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to the input stream from which the PNG image is read.

parameters.name: st
parameters.description: Pointer to the decoder status structure, which is used to store information about the decoding process.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. If the function completes successfully, it returns S_OK. If an error occurs, it returns an error code.

function.name: png_decoder_get_frame_info
function.description: This function retrieves the frame information from a PNG decoder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the decoder interface

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: Frame number to get information for

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure where the frame information will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if successful

function.name: png_decoder_get_decoder_palette
function.description: This function is used to get the decoder palette of a PNG decoder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is an interface to the decoder structure.

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: This represents the frame for which the palette is to be obtained.

parameters.name: colors
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the colors in the palette.

parameters.name: num_colors
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the number of colors in the palette.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. In this case, it always returns WINCODEC_ERR_PALETTEUNAVAILABLE, indicating that the palette is not available.

function.name: png_decoder_copy_pixels
function.description: This function copies pixels from a PNG decoder frame to a buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the decoder structure

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: Frame number to be decoded

parameters.name: prc
parameters.description: Pointer to a WICRect structure that specifies the portion of the image to copy

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Stride of the destination bitmap

parameters.name: buffersize
parameters.description: Size of the buffer

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer where the pixels will be copied

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value can be one of the error values.

function.name: png_decoder_get_metadata_blocks
function.description: This function reads PNG chunks from a stream, identifies metadata chunks, and stores their details in an array of decoder_block structures. It also keeps track of the total number of metadata blocks found.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the decoder structure

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: Frame number to be decoded

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the function will store the total number of metadata blocks found

parameters.name: blocks
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an array of decoder_block structures where the function will store the details of each metadata block found

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: png_decoder_get_color_context
function.description: This function allocates memory for color profile data, copies the color profile data into the allocated memory, and returns the size of the color profile data.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface of the decoder

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: Frame number

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: Number of color contexts

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the color profile data

parameters.name: datasize
parameters.description: Size of the color profile data

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: png_decoder_destroy
function.description: This function frees up the memory allocated to the image bits, color profile, and the png_decoder structure itself.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the decoder structure that needs to be destroyed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: png_decoder_create
function.description: This function creates a PNG decoder, initializes it, and assigns it to the result. It also sets the container format, block format, and clsid of the info structure.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to a decoder_info structure. The function sets its container_format, block_format, and clsid fields.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to a decoder structure. The function creates a new png_decoder, initializes it, and assigns its address to *result.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, and S_OK otherwise.

function.name: impl_from_encoder
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a png_encoder structure that contains the given encoder structure.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an encoder structure.

function.return_type: struct png_encoder*, represents a pointer to a png_encoder structure that contains the given encoder structure.

function.name: user_write_data
function.description: This function writes data to a PNG structure. It checks if the writing process was successful and if the written bytes match the expected length.

parameters.name: png_ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to the PNG structure where the data is to be written

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data to be written

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: The length of the data to be written

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: user_flush
function.description: This function is currently empty and does not perform any operation.

parameters.name: png_ptr
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to a png_struct, which is typically used for handling PNG images.

function.return_type: void, which means this function does not return any value.

function.name: png_encoder_initialize
function.description: This function initializes a PNG encoder. It sets up the libpng structures, error handling, and custom I/O handling.

parameters.name: encoder
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the encoder structure that needs to be initialized.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the stream where the encoded data will be written.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, and E_FAIL if there is an error during execution.

function.name: png_encoder_get_supported_format
function.description: This function checks the supported format for png encoder by comparing the provided pixel format with the available formats. If a match is found, it sets the pixel format, bits per pixel (bpp), and a boolean flag indicating whether the color type is palette or not.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the encoder structure

parameters.name: pixel_format
parameters.description: Pointer to the GUID representing pixel format

parameters.name: bpp
parameters.description: Pointer to the DWORD representing bits per pixel

parameters.name: indexed
parameters.description: Pointer to the BOOL flag indicating whether the color type is palette or not

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, returns S_OK if the operation is successful

function.name: png_encoder_create_frame
function.description: This function creates a frame for a PNG encoder. It sets up the frame's properties, handles errors, and writes the frame's information.

parameters.name: encoder
parameters.description: Pointer to the encoder structure which contains the encoder's properties.

parameters.name: encoder_frame
parameters.description: Pointer to the encoder frame structure which contains the frame's properties.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, E_FAIL if there is an error during execution, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: png_encoder_write_lines
function.description: This function writes lines to a PNG encoder. If the encoder frame is interlaced, it stores the data for multiple passes in Commit. Otherwise, it writes rows directly to the PNG encoder.

parameters.name: encoder
parameters.description: Pointer to the encoder structure

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data to be written

parameters.name: line_count
parameters.description: Number of lines to be written

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Stride of the data

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, E_FAIL if there was an error during the operation, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation failed

function.name: png_encoder_commit_frame
function.description: This function commits a frame for a PNG encoder. It sets up error handling, checks for interlacing, allocates memory for row pointers, writes rows for each pass if interlacing is enabled, and finally writes the end of the PNG file.

parameters.name: encoder
parameters.description: A pointer to the encoder structure that is used for the PNG encoding process.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_FAIL if there is an error in the setjmp/longjmp error handling, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation for row pointers fails.

function.name: png_encoder_commit_file
function.description: This function commits a PNG encoder file.

parameters.name: encoder
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the encoder structure.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, returns S_OK if the operation is successful.

function.name: png_encoder_destroy
function.description: This function destroys the PNG encoder, freeing up the memory allocated to it.

parameters.name: encoder
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the encoder structure that needs to be destroyed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: png_encoder_create
function.description: This function creates a PNG encoder, initializes its properties, and sets the encoder options.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to an encoder_info structure that will be filled with information about the encoder.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an encoder structure. This will be set to point to the newly created encoder.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.
